interfaceCtat.descricao: Interface FIXA do tutor (a mesma tela para todos os problemas): enunciado com as partes da tarefa e, abaixo, uma TABELA de razões com três linhas — Total, Part 1 e Part 2 — e, em cada linha, quatro grupos de células: (1) a razão ORIGINAL (numerador e denominador, dois campos); (2) a coluna "Operation": dois seletores em que o aluno escolhe × ou ÷ (um para o numerador, um para o denominador); (3) a coluna "Scale Factor": dois campos com o fator aplicado ao numerador e ao denominador; (4) o RESULTADO: um campo para o numerador da razão equivalente, cujo denominador já vem impresso como 100 (isto é, a porcentagem), e um campo para o valor da porcentagem. Botão Hint; botão Done. Cada célula preenchida é um passo do aluno; a tabela inteira tem 24 células a completar.

dicas.texto: In a part-to-whole ratio, decide which quantity describes the part and which describes the entire supply.
Read the Part 1 information and place the number of interested people in the numerator cell.
Part 1 tells you that ... people want to buy bracelets, so use that quantity for the numerator.
Click the Part 1 original numerator cell and enter the number of people stated for Part 1.
A scale factor tells how many times a quantity must be multiplied to reach an equivalent ratio.
Find the factor by dividing the desired denominator by the original denominator.
Compare 100 with 40 by calculating 100 divided by 40, rather than subtracting the two values.
Choose the option produced by dividing the target denominator, 100, by the original denominator, 40.
Equivalent ratios keep the same relationship when both numerator and denominator are multiplied by the same factor.
Multiply the original Part 1 numerator by the scale factor used to change 40 into 100.
Use 42 as the numerator and multiply it by 2.5; do not add the factor to the numerator.
In the Part 1 percentage-numerator cell, calculate 42 times 2.5 and enter the resulting whole-number numerator.
A ratio with denominator 100 can be read directly as a percentage.
Apply the same scale factor used for the supply to the Part 2 numerator.
Multiply the Part 2 quantity, 108, by 2.5 to convert the ratio to a denominator of 100.
In the Part 2 percentage cell, calculate 108 times 2.5 and enter that value as the percentage.
